get_blob_triangulation_config: get a BlobTriangulationConfig for a given robot type by calling get_config with the robot name string
create_blob_triangulation_config_datacla: create a BlobTriangulationConfig dataclass instance to hold ROS node name, rate, queue sizes, extrinsics, limits, and deadzones
configure_extrinsics_from_robot_config: configure camera extrinsics by extracting them from the robot config cameras dictionary into the triangulation config
set_position_limits_for_outlier_filterin: set Cartesian position limits using PositionLimit upper and lower bounds to filter outlier triangulated points
define_deadzones_for_robot_space: define deadzone PositionLimit regions like front_left and front_right to exclude volumes where points are discarded
